The '''scrubber droid''' was a fifth-degree [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] produced by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:ScrubberDroid.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A scrubber droid in the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]].]]

This series of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] was designed to clean up hazardous materials from [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] and [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] areas. The scrubber, which resembled a squat box, moved about in search of [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] spills and other areas where potentially dangerous chemicals pooled. It could communicate with the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system. The box-shaped droid was equipped with fuel scrubbers and two sensors called "sniffers" to detect any dangerous fuel leaks.<ref name="SWCVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

The scrubber was effective at its work, collecting as much of the hazardous material as possible without any sort of fear of its dangerous situation. In those situations where a [[Fire/Legends|fire]] broke out before the scrubber could clean up a spill, the droid was equipped with a [[Fire extinguisher/Legends|fire extinguisher]] to put out a variety of fire types.

==History==
[[File:WattosScrubberDroids-TPM.png|right|thumb|A couple of old Scrubber models found in Watto's shop.]]
A scrubber droid model was used by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Yet two other scrubber droids were found in [[Wald's Parts|Watto's shop]] above two [[GNK power droid/Legends|GNK power droid]]s.
